verdict.rationale: AFK's docs describe autonomous background execution: reads run automatically, tasks decompose into directed graphs with parallel/blocked steps that resume automatically, and processes carry forward asking only for human decisions when needed. This is all first-party claimed-docs with no independent or hands-on corroboration, and probes for API/llms.txt surfaces returned 404s, suggesting limited technical documentation depth. Missing for 10: independent verification of autonomous operation, technical API/architecture documentation, and evidence of long-running unattended execution in practice.
